title: Meetings
ringkas: Agenda, berpendapat, menyela dengan sopan, dan notulen
goals: memahami alur rapat: **agenda**, pembukaan, pembahasan, **action items**, dan penutupan
membuka dan menutup rapat dengan ungkapan yang tepat
meminta dan memberi pendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju secara profesional
menyela, meminta klarifikasi, dan merangkum dengan sopan

lesson.text: Rapat yang baik **terarah, singkat, dan menghasilkan keputusan**. Rapat yang buruk membuang waktu. Di unit ini kamu belajar ungkapan untuk ikut serta dalam rapat, dari membuka sampai membagi tugas, serta cara menulis notulen.

lesson.title: 1. Alur rapat
table: [[Let's get started.]] / [[Thank you all for coming.]]
[[Let's move on to the next point.]]
[[Dina, could you prepare the report by Friday?]]

lesson.title: 2. Berpendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju
table: [[What do you think about ...?]] / [[Does anyone have any comments?]] / [[What's your view on ...?]]
[[In my opinion, ...]] / [[I think we should ...]] / [[From my point of view, ...]]
[[I agree with you.]] / [[That's a good point.]] / [[Exactly.]]
[[I see what you mean, but ...]] / [[You have a point, however ...]]
[[I'm afraid I see it differently.]] / [[I understand, but I'm not sure that ...]]

lesson.title: 3. Menyela, klarifikasi, dan merangkum
table: [[Sorry to interrupt, but ...]] / [[Can I just add something?]]
[[Could you clarify what you mean by ...?]] / [[Do you mean that ...?]]

items.ex: Mr. Adi will chair the meeting.
Apologies from Tom, who is ill.

lesson.title: 5. Membuat keputusan dan membagi tugas
table: [[So, it's decided: we will ...]] / [[We've agreed to ...]]
[[Could you take care of ...?]] / [[Dina, you will be responsible for ...]]
[[I'll take care of it.]] / [[I can do that by Friday.]]
[[Let's meet again on Monday to review progress.]]

lesson.title: 6. Notulen (minutes)
table: [[Present: Mr. Adi, Ms. Sari, Dina, Tom]] / [[Apologies: Budi]]
[[It was agreed that the launch will be postponed.]]
[[Action: Dina to send the report by Friday.]]

lesson.title: Bahasa notulen
lesson.text: Notulen memakai **simple past** dan **passive voice**: [[It was agreed that ...]], [[The budget was approved.]], [[Tom was asked to ...]]. Ditulis dari sudut pandang orang ketiga, singkat, dan faktual.

lines.en: Good morning, everyone. Thank you all for coming. Let's get started.
lines.id: Selamat pagi semuanya. Terima kasih sudah hadir. Mari kita mulai.

lines.en: Today we have three items on the agenda: the sales report, the new budget, and the launch date.
lines.id: Hari ini ada tiga butir agenda: laporan penjualan, anggaran baru, dan tanggal peluncuran.

lines.en: Dina will take the minutes. Tom sends his apologies; he is ill today.
lines.id: Dina akan mencatat notulen. Tom menyampaikan permohonan maaf; ia sakit hari ini.

lines.en: Shall we begin with the sales report?
lines.id: Bagaimana kalau kita mulai dengan laporan penjualan?

lines.en: What do you think about moving the launch to June?
lines.id: Bagaimana pendapat kalian tentang memindahkan peluncuran ke bulan Juni?

lines.en: In my opinion, it's a good idea. We need more time to test the product.
lines.id: Menurut saya itu ide bagus. Kita butuh waktu lebih untuk menguji produk.

lines.en: I see what you mean, but the customers are waiting. How about a smaller launch in May?
lines.id: Saya paham maksud Ibu, tetapi pelanggan sedang menunggu. Bagaimana kalau peluncuran kecil di bulan Mei?

lines.en: That's a good point. Sorry to interrupt, Dina, but could you clarify what you mean by a smaller launch?
lines.id: Itu poin bagus. Maaf menyela, Dina, tetapi bisakah kamu menjelaskan maksud peluncuran kecil?

lines.en: A launch for 100 selected customers first. We can fix any problems before the full launch.
lines.id: Peluncuran untuk 100 pelanggan terpilih dulu. Kita bisa memperbaiki masalah sebelum peluncuran penuh.

lines.en: To sum up, we agreed on a smaller launch in May and a full launch in June.
lines.id: Singkatnya, kita sepakat peluncuran kecil di bulan Mei dan peluncuran penuh di bulan Juni.

lines.en: Dina, could you prepare the customer list by Friday?
lines.id: Dina, bisakah kamu menyiapkan daftar pelanggan sebelum Jumat?

lines.en: Yes, I'll take care of it.
Good. That's all for today. Thank you, everyone.
lines.id: Bagus. Itu saja untuk hari ini. Terima kasih semuanya.

read.id:
Rapat Proyek Mingguan – 14 Juni, pukul 10.00. Peserta: Rina (ketua), Doni, Maya, dan Ben. Agenda: 1. Pembaruan kemajuan 2. Anggaran 3. Langkah berikutnya.
Doni melaporkan bahwa tahap desain sudah 80 persen selesai. Maya menyampaikan kekhawatiran tentang anggaran, yang melebihi perkiraan sepuluh persen. Tim sepakat mengurangi jumlah materi cetak. Butir tindakan: Ben akan mengirim anggaran revisi paling lambat Jumat, dan Rina akan memberi tahu klien. Rapat berikutnya akan diadakan pada 21 Juni.

qs.q: How far along is the design phase?

qs.exp: Teks: "agreed to reduce the number of printed materials."
qs.q: What did the team agree to do about the budget?

read.text:
Weekly Project Meeting – 14 June, 10.00 a.m. Attendees: Rina (chair), Doni, Maya, and Ben. Agenda: 1. Progress update 2. Budget 3. Next steps.
Doni reported that the design phase was 80 percent complete. Maya raised a concern about the budget, which was ten percent over the estimate. The team agreed to reduce the number of printed materials. Action items: Ben will send the revised budget by Friday, and Rina will inform the client. The next meeting will be held on 21 June.
read.title: Meeting Minutes

read.id:
Ketua: Mari kita lanjut ke butir berikutnya, situs web baru. Maya, bagaimana pendapatmu?
Maya: Menurut saya kita sebaiknya meluncurkan bulan depan. Namun, saya khawatir kita tidak punya cukup waktu untuk pengujian. Doni: Boleh saya menambahkan? Kita bisa meluncurkan versi sederhana dulu dan menambah fitur nanti. Maya: Itu poin yang bagus. Saya setuju dengan Doni. Ketua: Bagus. Mari kita jalankan rencana itu.

qs.exp: Chair: "the next item, the new website."
Maya: "we don't have enough time for testing."
options: The cost, because the website is expensive
The design, because it is not modern
The client, because he is very strict
Delay the launch of the site for a year
Hire a new team to build the website
Cancel the website and start another project
Delay the launch for another full year
Cancel the project and stop all the work
Ask the client to decide on everything
qs.q: What is decided in the end?

read.text:
Chair: Let's move on to the next item, the new website. Maya, what do you think?
Maya: I think we should launch next month. However, I'm worried we don't have enough time for testing. Doni: May I add something? We could launch a simple version first and add more features later. Maya: That's a good point. I agree with Doni. Chair: Great. Let's go with that plan.
